summary: Completed testing of AGRICAM IA Iteration 34: DJI Drone Management Module. ALL BACKEND TESTS PASSED (11/11). ALL FRONTEND TESTS PASSED. New drone management features working correctly with fleet, missions, live telemetry simulation, and photo gallery with AI analysis.

endpoints_tested: GET /api/drone-manager/fleet - Returns list of drones with status, battery, flights_count
POST /api/drone-manager/fleet - Creates new drone with auto-generated serial number
GET /api/drone-manager/missions - Returns list of missions with waypoints, status
POST /api/drone-manager/missions - Creates new mission with altitude, speed, overlap settings
GET /api/drone-manager/stats - Returns total_drones, total_missions, completed_missions, total_photos, flight_time, area_surveyed, success_rate
GET /api/drone-manager/simulation/telemetry - Returns simulated telemetry with lat/lng, altitude, battery, speed, heading, gps_signal, wind_speed, temperature
Telemetry changes dynamically over time (circular flight pattern simulation)
GET /api/drone-manager/photos - Returns photos with AI analysis (NDVI, health, disease_detected, crop_type, growth_stage)
